headline: This law names the North American bison the national mammal of the United States.
what_it_does: The act formally adopts the North American bison as the national mammal of the United States. It is a symbolic designation and does not create new programs, funding, or rules. The summary does not describe any other effects.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 9, 2016.
